Rolling Stone describes Wilson as a musician whose country sound intertwines with alternative rock. Oasis themselves opted out of attending the ceremony, as did Sade and Iron Maiden, so Wilson's performance stood in for the absent band on the night. It was one of the ceremony's more talked-about moments, a stripped-back reading of one of the most famous songs in British rock, delivered by an artist from a different tradition entirely.

articles.title: Red Hot Chili Peppers don bushy Rick Rubin beards for a wild Rock Hall performance
articles.description: Red Hot Chili Peppers honoured legendary producer Rick Rubin at the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame ceremony, donning their bushiest Rick Rubin-style beards for a wild performance of 'Give It Away'. Rubin was a Musical Excellence Award recipient at the ceremony.
articles.body: Red Hot Chili Peppers donned their bushiest Rick Rubin beards for a wild performance at the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony, honouring the legendary producer with a performance of 'Give It Away'. Rubin was a recipient of the Musical Excellence Award at the ceremony, alongside Philly soul songwriter Linda Creed and producers Arif Mardin and Jimmy Miller, and the band's tribute was both a visual gag and a musical salute to one of the most important producers in rock history. The Chili Peppers have worked with Rubin across decades of their career, and the beard tribute played on his famously hirsute image. The performance was one of the livelier moments of a ceremony that also featured Cynthia Erivo's dramatic rendition of Phil Collins's 'In the Air Tonight' and Stephen Wilson Jr.'s acoustic 'Wonderwall'. The 2026 induction ceremony was taped on November 14 at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles and will air on ABC on December 8 and on Disney+ the following day.

articles.title: Could 'Rubber Soul' be the best Beatles album? Rob Sheffield says yes
articles.description: Rolling Stone critic Rob Sheffield makes the case that 'Rubber Soul' is the best Beatles album, in a new piece asking the question directly and answering it in the affirmative.
articles.body: Rolling Stone critic Rob Sheffield has weighed in on one of the most durable debates in popular music, asking whether 'Rubber Soul' could be the best Beatles album and answering, in short, yes. The piece is a fresh entry in the magazine's long-running Beatles criticism, arguing for the 1965 album that marked the band's turn from pop hitmakers to studio innovators. 'Rubber Soul' sits between the early Beatlemania records and the psychedelic breakthroughs of 'Revolver' and 'Sgt. Pepper's', and Sheffield's case rests on its songwriting, its folk-rock turn and its status as the record where the Beatles became, unmistakably, an albums band. The argument will find plenty of takers and plenty of dissenters, which is rather the point of ranking the Beatles' catalogue six decades on. The piece appeared in Rolling Stone's music coverage on November 16, alongside the magazine's continuing coverage of the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame ceremony and the GTA VI soundtrack leak.

articles.title: Rolling Stone UK Awards 2026 nominees revealed, including the Album Award
articles.description: Rolling Stone UK has announced the nominees for its 2026 Awards, including the Album Award, with the ceremony taking place next week. The nominees span a wide range of British and international releases from the past year.
articles.body: Rolling Stone UK has revealed the nominees for its 2026 Awards, with the Album Award among the categories announced. The nominees were presented in a grid of album artworks spanning a wide range of British and international releases from the past year, reflecting the breadth of the magazine's coverage. The awards ceremony takes place next week, and the nominees announcement is the magazine's latest step in building its UK awards into a fixture of the British music calendar. The reveal follows a busy weekend for the Rolling Stone brand, with the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony in Los Angeles and the confirmation of the leaked GTA VI soundtrack tracklist dominating its music coverage. The full list of nominees is available on Rolling Stone UK's channels.

articles.title: Oak Ridge Boys bass singer Richard Sterban dies at 83
articles.description: Richard Sterban, the Oak Ridge Boys' bass singer for more than half a century and the voice behind the famous low refrain on 'Elvira', died on Saturday, November 14 in Hendersonville, Tennessee. He was 83. His family said he died of complications from bronchitis and pneumonia after a long battle with cancer. Rolling Stone marked his death with a list of the quartet's ten essential songs.
articles.body: Richard Sterban, whose deep bass voice anchored The Oak Ridge Boys for more than half a century, died on Saturday, November 14, 2026, in Hendersonville, Tennessee. He was 83. His family and the band said he died of complications from bronchitis and pneumonia after fighting a long, hard battle with cancer; he had shared a pancreatic cancer diagnosis in 2025 and stepped back from performing that September. Sterban joined the Oak Ridge Boys in late 1972, leaving a job singing behind Elvis Presley, and his rumbling refrain on the 1981 hit 'Elvira' became one of the most familiar sounds in American music. He remained with the group through more than five decades, rejoined them at the Grand Ole Opry in January 2026 to sing 'Elvira' to a standing ovation, and sang on the group's October 2026 album Buried Treasures. The Country Music Association said it was deeply saddened by the passing of a singer who helped make the quartet one of country's longest-lasting acts. Rolling Stone marked his death with a list of the group's ten essential songs, from 'Elvira' to 'American Made'.

articles.title: Olivia Rodrigo's album spends a fifth week at No. 1 on the Billboard 200, tying her SOUR run
articles.description: Olivia Rodrigo's 'you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love' notches a fifth nonconsecutive week at No. 1 on the Billboard 200 (chart dated November 21), tying her debut album SOUR for her longest run at the top. The set earned 62,000 equivalent album units in the latest tracking week, up 9%.
articles.body: Olivia Rodrigo's 'you seem pretty sad for a girl so in love' has secured a fifth nonconsecutive week at No. 1 on the Billboard 200, on the chart dated November 21, 2026, tying SOUR, her debut album from 2021, for her most weeks atop the list among her three chart-topping albums. In the tracking week ending November 12, the set earned 62,000 equivalent album units in the United States, up 9% according to Luminate, including 54.48 million official on-demand streams. The album now leads all albums released in 2026 for weeks at No. 1, moving ahead of Drake's ICEMAN, which recorded four weeks, and it ties Taylor Swift's The Life of a Showgirl for the most weeks at No. 1 during 2026. The week was highly competitive: Lil Baby's FRESH debuted at No. 2 with 59,000 units, just 3,000 behind Rodrigo, while P1Harmony's BLOW UP entered at No. 4 with 45,000 units. Streaming remained the biggest contributor to Rodrigo's total, with 51,000 streaming-equivalent units, while traditional album sales rose 53% to 11,000 units. The full November 21 chart will be posted on Billboard's website on November 17.

articles.title: P1Harmony's 'BLOW UP' debuts at No. 1 on Top Album Sales and No. 4 on the Billboard 200
articles.description: P1Harmony have scored the first No. 1 album of their career on Billboard's Top Album Sales chart. Their new mini album 'BLOW UP' debuted at the top, making it the best-selling album in the United States that week, and it also entered the Billboard 200 at No. 4 with 45,000 equivalent album units.
articles.body: P1Harmony have just scored the first No. 1 album of their career on Billboard's Top Album Sales chart, with their new mini album 'BLOW UP' debuting at the top and becoming the best-selling album in the United States that week. Billboard announced the news on November 15. Beyond the Top Album Sales win, 'BLOW UP' also debuted at No. 4 on the Billboard 200, the chart that ranks the most popular albums in the United States, tying the group's personal best and becoming their third top-10 album. The set earned 45,000 equivalent album units in the tracking week ending November 12, according to Luminate, with approximately 43,500 of those units coming from traditional album sales, compared with just 1,500 streaming-equivalent units. The record was available in 25 CD variants and five vinyl versions, with collectible elements including photocards and posters, some of them randomised, making the physical editions a notable part of the release strategy. The result underlines the enduring power of K-pop physical sales in the US market, where dedicated fanbases can still drive an album to the top of the sales chart.

articles.title: ILLIT tops Billboard's World Albums chart as IVE debuts and enters the Billboard 200 for the first time
articles.description: Billboard has published its World Albums chart for the week ending November 14. ILLIT's 'BREAK EVEN' rose to No. 1 following its physical release in the United States, while IVE's 'Looks Can Kill' debuted at No. 2 and became IVE's first album ever to enter the Billboard 200.
articles.body: Billboard has published its World Albums chart for the week ending on November 14, and K-pop dominates the top of the ranking. ILLIT's new mini album 'BREAK EVEN' rose to No. 1 on the World Albums chart following its physical release in the United States, adding to a week in which the EP also became the group's first-ever top-10 album on the Billboard 200 and their first album to hit No. 1 on Billboard's Top Album Sales chart. IVE's new mini album 'Looks Can Kill' debuted at No. 2 on the World Albums chart, and it also became IVE's first album ever to enter the Billboard 200. Stray Kids landed a total of four albums on this week's World Albums chart, with 'THIS & THAT' at No. 3, 'KARMA' at No. 7, 'DO IT' at No. 19 and 'ATE' re-entering at No. 25. CORTIS's 'GREENGREEN' ranked No. 4 in its 27th week on the chart, ENHYPEN's 'THE SIN : BLISS' held at No. 5, League of Legends' virtual group K/DA took No. 8 with 'FIRESTARTER', and BTS charted three entries, led by 'Map of the Soul: 7 ~The Journey~' at No. 10. The chart is a snapshot of K-pop's depth on the American market, with established acts holding long runs alongside new debuts.

articles.title: Billboard gives free streams more weight from January 2027, and YouTube returns to its charts
articles.category: Billboard has changed how it weighs free, ad-supported streams against paid subscription streams on its US charts, narrowing the ratio from 1:2.5 to 1:1.5 from the charts dated January 16, 2027. YouTube confirmed the same day that its data will return to Billboard's charts in 2027 after almost a year away.

opportunities.description: Workspace residency for lens-based artists only — only fits if he has photo-based work. 10 images + up to 1 video (3 min max), 300-word letter of intent with exhibition proposal, 300-word artist statement, 1-page CV, 2 references. Deadline Nov 25, 11:59 PM ET; will not be extended.
opportunities.eligibility: Emerging lens-based artists living in NYC who have not yet had a solo show in the city; not enrolled in a degree program as of Jan 1, 2026

opportunities.title: Mabou Mines SUITE/space Residency 2027–2029
opportunities.description: Two $4,000 stipends + 100 hours of rehearsal space at Mabou Mines, 150 First Ave (East Village). Residency Sep 1, 2027–Jun 30, 2029. Applications opened Oct 19, 2026. Deadline Nov 22, 11:59 PM ET.
opportunities.eligibility: Early-career interdisciplinary performance artists (up to 10 yrs practice) residing in the NYC area; not enrolled in undergrad/grad programs

opportunities.title: EFA SHIFT x MOMUS Residency
opportunities.organizer: Elizabeth Foundation for the Arts (EFA) + Momus
opportunities.description: Applications opened Nov 1 and close Tue Dec 15, 2026 at 11:59 PM. Residency runs Jul–Dec 2027 at EFA Studios, 323 W 39th St, NYC, under mentorship of Ajay Kurian (NewCrits). Requires orientation lunch, five critical seminars, Open Studios and a public panel. Strong fit for Andrew as an artist who writes.
opportunities.eligibility: New York area-based artists who write, or writers who make art

opportunities.title: EFA New Member Open Call 2027 (Studio Program)
opportunities.description: New Member Open Call 2027 — studio program. Applications opened Oct 1 and close Dec 1, 2026; free application (statement, work samples, resume).
opportunities.eligibility: Visual artists; applications considered by a panel of arts professionals, move-in starting May 2027
